metadata.note: Dual-arm desk/base relation for teleop_runtime where desk axes are +x=forward, +y=left, +z=up, while the default viewer places left_arm at desk -Y (screen-left) and right_arm at desk +Y (screen-right).
metadata.home_policy: session home anchors are intentionally not saved; real teleop must recapture wrist home

left.semantics: Arm pose actions control the active tool TCP. The TCP is loaded from the arm/tool calibration profile at execution time; RM65 backends convert this software TCP target to the internal IK/control frame.

right.semantics: Arm pose actions control the active tool TCP. The TCP is loaded from the arm/tool calibration profile at execution time; RM65 backends convert this software TCP target to the internal IK/control frame.

left.semantics: DM-Tac gripper uses the fixed 6-wide hand slot for compatibility; only slot 0 / gripper_close is a real actuator target and the other slots are padding.
